question: Does the stronger 13WM all-four-row common-numerator contradiction also invalidate the source-original 遲-only 820 reciprocal construction for the two NCL06272 table-B 遲 cells?

scope_sources.catalogued_holding: NCL06272, 1608 Sun Wei print family, physical impression/plate independence not proven
scope_sources.original_scoped_instruction: NCL06272 juan45 source p60: 右置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法
scope_sources.source_limited_lanes: Only the two printed 遲 cells at limit 35 and limit 132; no 疾-side construction assumed or adjudicated

conditional_model.numerator_note: The conversion of printed 八百二十 into N=8200000000 and of source printed fields into integer rate/coefficient scales is a declared conditional modern normalization, NOT an attested ancient 少/微 radix.
conditional_model.coefficient_rule: floor(N/R); N fixed across the two 遲 cells; hidden R may differ per source row and retain unprinted fractional places
conditional_model.rate_display_rule: floor(R) (the chosen examples also satisfy nearest-integer display, but the historical printing rule remains unknown)

shared_N_floor_rate_display_admissible_i.interpretation: Each 遲 row permits a shared N within its own non-exact projected interval; their intersection is nonempty. Exact rational examples with fixed N further prove feasibility.

conditional_model.replay_method: Integer BigInt divisions and inequalities without float rounding, assumed damaged glyph completions, OCR, extra scan or ancient formula back-fitting

conclusion.precise_reconciliation: 13WM rejects forcing the same numerator and floor inverse on BOTH 疾 and 遲; it DOES NOT refute the originally printed 遲-specific 820 reciprocal instruction. With N=8200000000, the two already collated 遲 cells have exact admissible hidden-R witnesses. 13WL separately proves a cross-lane low-rate two-cell existence; that remains a different, narrower logical claim.
cannot_conclude: That these illustrative hidden rates were historically stored, that the historical source truncated rather than rounded, or that its literal 八百二十 maps to this modern scaled numerator.
That a 疾-side constructor equals this 遲 reciprocal or that 13WM's 疾 mismatch is a manuscript error.
That NCL06272 and NCL06273 share or differ in original plates, or that Xu-An damaged 二/三 is now legible.
That G893/G892 has matching ancient rate units, original 少/微 carry, or any of six independent historical final awards.

next_action: Highest priority remains original independent Xu-An second-limit-table L132 二/三 and source-specific 疾 捷法 construction plus 少/微 radix/carry. Avoid extrapolating a uniform two-lane operator from a source-attested 遲-only instruction.
